tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background (`body`). Everything sits on it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Text inputs and elevation sample cards — the raised field on `bg`.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Code blocks (the Markdown panes) and the setup hint box.

tokens.name: fill
tokens.usage: Chip and font-family tag fill; hover wash behind inactive tabs and secondary buttons.

tokens.name: fill-strong
tokens.usage: Badge fill: the header mode kicker and section provenance badges.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: tab-bar rules, card and swatch borders, outline chips, thumbnails.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders: text input, secondary button, dashed dropzone. Below 3:1 on `bg` in both themes — kept as the source has it.

tokens.name: line-hover
tokens.usage: Dropzone border on hover.

tokens.name: line-focus
tokens.usage: Text-input border on focus (paired with `ring`).

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring around a focused input. Faint by itself; `line-focus` carries the 3:1.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on `bg`, `surface`, `surface-sunken`, `fill`.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Dropzone call-to-action label on `bg`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: the intro paragraph, inactive tab labels, badge text, hint text. Reads on `bg`, `surface-sunken`, `fill-strong`.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: meta labels, help copy, hex values, loading line, uppercase list labels. Meets 4.5:1 on `bg` and `surface` in light; in dark only 4.2:1 on `bg` and 3.8:1 on `surface` — a source pair that misses AA, kept exact. Keep it to non-essential text.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Smallest annotations: token names in the type scale, swatch usage line, `img` tag. Fails AA in light (≈2.5:1 on `surface`) — kept exact from the source; don't use it for anything a reader must read.

tokens.name: ink-code
tokens.usage: Inline `code` inside the hint box, on `surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: mark
tokens.usage: Non-text graphics: spacing bars, radius-sample outlines.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary button and active tab/segment fill. Inverts per theme.

tokens.name: action-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button fill on hover.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Text on `action` and `action-hover`.

tokens.name: danger-bg
tokens.usage: Error alert fill.

tokens.name: danger-line
tokens.usage: Error alert border.

tokens.name: danger-ink
tokens.usage: Error alert text on `danger-bg`.

tokens.name: warning-bg
tokens.usage: Warning notice fill (structure unavailable).

tokens.name: warning-line
tokens.usage: Warning notice border.

tokens.name: warning-ink
tokens.usage: Warning notice text on `warning-bg`.

tokens.name: pass-ink
tokens.usage: WCAG verdict word `AA`/`AAA` in contrast chips, on `bg`. Always paired with the verdict word, never colour alone.

tokens.name: fail-ink
tokens.usage: WCAG verdict word `fail` in contrast chips, on `bg`. Differs from `pass-ink` mainly by hue — the word carries the meaning.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Image-thumbnail remove button (`bg-black/60`); `white` text on it over any photo.

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', 'Noto Sans', Arial, sans-serif, 'Apple Color Emoji', 'Segoe UI Emoji', 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Noto Color Emoji'
families.mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', 'Courier New', monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The product name in the page header (`text-4xl font-semibold tracking-tight`). One per page.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section titles in the results preview (`text-lg font-semibold`), followed by a provenance Badge.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Point it at a URL for a measured Design System report.
styles.usage: Default body text and the intro paragraph.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: Buttons, tabs, dropzone label, meta values, swatch role names (`text-sm font-medium`).

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Inputs, alerts, list items, identity description (`text-sm`).

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Multiple images merge into one palette.
styles.usage: Help copy, chips, hint box, spacing captions (`text-xs`).

styles.name: caption-strong
styles.usage: Small buttons and the header mode kicker (`text-xs font-medium`).

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Meta labels and list headings, set UPPERCASE (`text-xs uppercase tracking-wide`) in `ink-subtle`.

styles.name: badge
styles.usage: Provenance badge beside a section title, UPPERCASE (`text-[10px] font-medium uppercase tracking-wide`).

styles.name: mono-sm
styles.usage: Hex values, token names, spacing/radius values (`font-mono text-xs`).

styles.name: code-block
styles.usage: The Markdown output panes (`pre text-xs leading-relaxed`).

spacing.note: Tailwind v4 spacing: one 0.25rem unit (`--spacing`), multiplied. Only the steps the UI uses are listed.

tokens.name: space-0.5
tokens.usage: Badge vertical padding (`py-0.5`).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Chip vertical padding; `mt-1` under the identity archetype.

tokens.name: space-1.5
tokens.usage: Tab / small-button vertical padding; badge horizontal padding; list-item padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Default gap in rows of tabs, chips, thumbnails; tab-bar bottom padding; swatch caption padding.

tokens.name: space-2.5
tokens.usage: Button and input vertical padding; chip horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Tab / small-button horizontal padding; input-row gap; swatch grid gap; alert vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-3.5
tokens.usage: Hint box horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Input and alert horizontal padding; code-block padding; form row spacing (`space-y-4`); tab-bar bottom margin.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page side gutter (`px-6`); meta grid column gap; status message top margin.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Dropzone padding; vertical rhythm between result blocks (`space-y-8`).

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap between preview sections (`space-y-10`); header bottom margin; results top margin.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Page top and bottom padding (`py-16`).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: `rounded`: badges (header kicker, provenance).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: `rounded-md`: tabs, small buttons, tags, hint box, thumbnails, list items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: `rounded-lg`: primary buttons, text input, dropzone, alerts, swatch cards, code blocks, screenshots.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: `rounded-full`: chips (contrast pairs, identity adjectives). Tailwind writes calc(infinity * 1px).

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: The only shadow: screenshots of the analysed page. Everything else separates with `line` borders.

tokens.name: container-4xl
tokens.usage: Max width of the single centred column (`max-w-4xl mx-auto`).

tokens.name: size-swatch
tokens.usage: Swatch colour block height and thumbnail side (`h-16`).

tokens.name: size-sample
tokens.usage: Radius sample square (`h-12 w-12`).

tokens.name: size-dismiss
tokens.usage: Thumbnail remove button (`h-5 w-5`).

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: Every border and divider.

tokens.name: border-thick
tokens.usage: Dashed dropzone border, radius-sample outline, focus ring width.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled buttons (`disabled:opacity-50`), with `cursor: not-allowed`.

tokens.name: opacity-pulse
tokens.usage: Low point of the loading line's 2s pulse (`animate-pulse`).
